excerpt.zh: 我们的矿物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our mineral deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们的矿物赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
texts.en: Our mineral deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们帝国的矿物短缺在最近数月来愈发严峻。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]对前景的预期从担忧转为愤怒，这表明我们很快就会用尽偿还债务的资源。他们预测，除非采取重大行动，否则在数月之后必须要大幅削减开支。
texts.en: Our empire's mineral shortages have become increasingly severe in recent months. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] has progressed from concerned to irate at the current forecasts, which suggest that we will soon run out of resources to pay off our debts. They predict that drastic cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months unless significant action is taken.

texts.zh: 我们帝国的矿物短缺在最近数月来愈发严峻。我们的资源分配子个体已经竭尽全力，仍然无法保证我们的后勤系统不崩溃。他们预测，除非采取重大行动，否则在数月之后必须要大幅削减开支。
texts.en: Our empire's mineral shortages have become increasingly severe in recent months. Our resource allocation drones are stretched to the limit, and are unable to guarantee against a breakdown of our logistics systems. They forecast that drastic cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months unless significant action is taken.

tooltips.zh: 关闭全部的克隆仓。我们就不再需要支出相应的维护费了。
tooltips.en: All active Clone Vats are disabled. We will no longer have to pay their upkeep.

label.zh: 我们可以从支持者那里借一点。
label.en: We can borrow from our supporters.
Everything is going according to plan.

texts.zh: 我们没能避免破产。经历了数月的矿物极度短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能拖欠债务并大幅削减开支。
texts.en: We have failed to stave off bankruptcy. Following months of mineral shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to default on our debts and make sharp cutbacks to our expenditures.

texts.zh: 我们没能平衡收支。经历了数月的矿物短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
texts.en: We have failed to rebalance our expenditures. Following months of mineral shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to enforce large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution systems.
